_comment: Question bank for bulk AI-answer testing (test_ai_on_bank.py).
Add as many questions as you want -- there's no fixed count like
the 5-question quizzes in test_bot.py.
Each entry:
id       -- stable number/string you'll reference later in
'deep investigate' mode to re-ask just that question.
Keep these stable once assigned -- don't renumber
existing entries, or old miss-reports will point at
the wrong question next time you run bulk mode.
text     -- the question. For bare-letter style (options embedded
in the question, like the real bot's Q1/Q5), write the
'A) ...' / 'B) ...' lines directly into this string,
same as test_bot.py's bare_letters questions do.
options  -- list of option strings. For bare-letter style, this is
just ["A", "B", "C", "D"] (see bare_letters below) --
same convention test_bot.py already uses.
correct  -- 0-based index into options of the right answer.
bare_letters -- true if options are embedded in text (see above),
false if options holds the real option text.
This mirrors test_bot.py's existing question dict shape exactly, so
the same _build_prompt() / _options_are_bare_letters() logic in
run_challenge.py applies unchanged.

questions.text: What is a trader actually paid from, once funded?

Do firms that disclose Demo accounts also tend to convert to live accounts?
A) Yes, always
B) Only sometimes
C) Not addressed
D) No
$50,000 account, 5% daily / 10% total drawdown. Day 3 closing loss for the day is $2,400, from a balance that was already down $2,000 from Day 2. Any limit breached?
